Get us as many app installs as possible; installs are what we count. Run Saturday, July 24, 2027 through Wednesday, July 28, 2027, all five days in our account's Central time. Use https://tervilo.app/school. Our site has no X pixel, so X can't see the installs. Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from the app stores there, so there's no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. We hold the licences required in the United States and Canada. X has approved our account for financial services ads in the United States and Canada. Launch and manage it yourself without asking for approval, watch it throughout the flight, and send a short recap afterward with spend, impressions and link clicks. Here's the copy from our landing page: "Tervilo is a Houston-based money transfer app for people in the United States and Canada supporting family abroad. Keep school expenses organized with saved recipients and transfer receipts in one place. Pay no transfer fee on your first transfer completed by July 28, 2027; exchange rates apply. Available only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones: choose your app store below to install."

Total budget: 650.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Flight complete — Jul 24–28, 2027 (America/Chicago).

**Setup**
- Campaign `kttp4` — WEBSITE_CLICKS / LINK_CLICKS to https://tervilo.app/school. No X pixel or app ID was available, so X could not measure or optimize for installs directly; link clicks were the install proxy.
- Targeting: United States + Canada, iOS + Android only.
- Promoted only your approved strong posts: `2212065130708528326` (ad group `3basu`) and `2212427518575471207` (ad group `swrnx`). I did not promote the vague post `2212246324639150169`, and wrote no new posts.
- Budget: $65/day + $325 total cap per ad group = $130/day, $650 total cap.

**Monitoring**
Checked daily. The two ad groups stayed essentially tied on link clicks throughout, so I kept the 50/50 split rather than reallocating on noise. Both posts remained ACCEPTED.

**Final results (Jul 24 05:00Z – Jul 29 05:00Z)**
- Spend: **$630.39** of the $650 cap ($19.61 unspent)
  - `3basu`: $315.78
  - `swrnx`: $314.60
- Impressions: **545,678**
  - `3basu`: 287,468
  - `swrnx`: 258,210
- Link clicks: **218**
  - `3basu`: 111 — $2.84 / click
  - `swrnx`: 107 — $2.94 / click

Campaign is now EXPIRED / not servable. Actual app installs are not in these numbers — with no pixel/app attribution, X reports clicks to the landing page only, not installs completed in the app stores.
